Master Yi

Jungle Pure meme

AP Master Yi (the legendary one!)

How to play this build

Iconic meme build: Alpha Strike (Q) scales with AP, makes you briefly untargetable and resets on kills. With Guinsoo + Nashor + Lich Bane you're a blender in Highlander (R). Clear jungle fast and snowball with ganks into unwarded lanes.

Skill order

Max priority:

Q Golpe Alfa → E Estilo Wuju → W Meditar

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Alpha Strike (Q) for AP damage and kill resets; Wuju (E) second. W (Meditate) at 1 point for jungle sustain.

Items and what they do

  1. Guinsoo's Rageblade Hybrid AD/AP that stacks attack speed and power the longer you fight.
  2. Nashor's Tooth AP, CDR and attack speed, plus magic on-hit. For AP champs that auto-attack.
  3. Lich Bane AP, mana and move speed; attack after a spell deals huge magic damage scaling with AP. Key for AP auto builds.
  4. Wit's End Attack speed and MR; magic on-hit that also steals the target's MR.
  5. Sorcerer's Shoes Boots with magic penetration.

Runes

In Season 3, runes were a system SEPARATE from masteries: bought with IP (Influence Points) and slotted into 4 tiers — Marks (red), Seals (yellow), Glyphs (blue) and Quintessences (purple, the strongest). They gave flat stats: damage, armor, penetration, etc.

Marks (red) Hybrid penetration ×9
Seals (yellow) Armor ×9
Glyphs (blue) Magic resist per level ×9
Quintessences (purple) Attack speed ×3

Magic pen, armor, hybrid AP quints

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/9/0 — Offense
Why this page
21/9/0 gives damage with durability to survive while spamming Alpha.
